title: How Far Out Should You Book Carpet Installation in Lynnwood? Lead Times Explained
meta: Book Lynnwood carpet installation 3 to 6 weeks ahead for in-stock carpet, 6 to 10 for special orders, longer near holidays. Wills Flooring explains why.
keywords: how far in advance to book carpet installation, carpet installation lead time, how long to get carpet installed, carpet install before moving in, carpet installation Lynnwood WA

blocks.lead: Book carpet installation in Lynnwood three to six weeks before you need it for an in-stock product, six to ten weeks for a special order, and add two weeks if your date falls between mid-October and New Year.
blocks.detail: The install itself takes a day or two. The waiting is in the estimate, the sample decision, the mill order and the delivery. Wills Flooring can often move faster than that from our Lynnwood showroom, but planning to these numbers means you never miss a move-in, a listing or a holiday.

blocks.html: The phone call usually goes like this: closing is on the 28th, the movers come on the 30th, and can we have four bedrooms and a staircase carpeted in between? Sometimes yes. Often the answer depends on decisions the homeowner has not made yet. In Lynnwood we hear it most from buyers of 1970s split-levels in Alderwood and Martha Lake, and from sellers near the light rail stations who need a listing ready by a certain weekend.

items.text: We usually reach a Lynnwood home within two to four days of the call, sooner if you are close to the 196th St showroom. We measure every room and staircase, check the subfloor and bring samples.
items.note: You get a firm written quote at the visit

items.text: This is the step homeowners underestimate. Fiber, color, pile and pad take most people a few evenings and a second look at the samples in daylight.
items.note: Keep the samples until you decide

items.text: Stock rolls from a regional warehouse arrive in about a week. Special-order colors, wool and patterned carpet ship from the mill and take three to six weeks.
items.note: We confirm the ship date before you commit

items.text: The roll comes to us, gets inspected for dye lot and defects, and is cut for your rooms. Catching a flaw here saves a week of reorder later.
items.note: Pad and tack strip are pulled from stock

items.text: A typical Lynnwood four-bedroom upstairs with a straight staircase is one long day. Whole-house jobs with furniture moves and old carpet removal run two.
items.note: Walk on it the same evening

items.title: Special-order colors and patterns
items.text: Any carpet that is not sitting on a warehouse rack is made or cut to order. Wool, patterned loops and the exact shade you saw online almost always mean a mill order. Plan six to ten weeks.

items.title: The fall and holiday rush
items.text: From mid-October until New Year, everyone in Snohomish County wants floors done before guests arrive. Install calendars fill three weeks out and mills slow for Thanksgiving. Book in September for December.

items.title: Occupied homes and furniture
items.text: An empty house can be scheduled any open day. A furnished one needs the crew to move beds and dressers, at $0.25 per sq ft, and often a second day. Timing the job before move-in gains you both speed and a better result.

items.title: Subfloor surprises
items.text: Pulling 1980s carpet in a Meadowdale rambler sometimes reveals squeaks, water stains or particleboard that needs replacing. We check what we can at the estimate, but repairs found on install day can add a day.

blocks.html: Booking early buys you a date, not a discount, and booking late does not cost you a rush fee. The labor rate is the same all year: $0.99 per sq ft stretch-in over pad, $1.29 glue-down, $30 per step, a 500 sq ft minimum, $0.45 per sq ft to haul the old carpet and pad away and $0.25 to move furniture. A four-bedroom Alderwood upstairs of 950 sq ft with 13 steps is 950 × $0.99 + 13 × $30 = $940.50 + $390 = $1,330.50 in labor, plus carpet and pad quoted at the estimate. What a tight date changes is which carpet you can have.

blocks.note: Labor only, and the rate is the same whatever week we install. Carpet and pad are quoted at the estimate.

blocks.text: Planning backward from a hard date

blocks.html: Take your deadline and subtract. If movers arrive on a Saturday, you want the carpet done by Wednesday so the house can air and you have a buffer for a delayed roll. Add a week for scheduling, a week for delivery, one to five weeks for the product to ship, and a week for you to choose. That is why the estimate should happen five to eight weeks before the move. Sellers count forward: carpet, then paint touch-ups, then photos.

blocks.title: Buying a Lynnwood house?
blocks.text: Ask your agent for a pre-closing walkthrough and schedule the estimate then. We can measure and hold a tentative install date so the order goes in the morning you get the keys. Most closings in Alderwood and Martha Lake leave enough time to have new carpet down before the truck arrives.

items.html: Choosing the color under showroom light because the date is tight. Carpet reads warmer at home. One evening with the samples on your floor prevents a ten-year regret.

Taking whatever is in stock instead of the fiber you need. A stock polyester for a family with two dogs on a staircase is a poor trade for three weeks. Read our guide to the best carpet for stairs first.
Installing carpet before the painters finish. Paint drips and ladder feet on new carpet. Carpet is the last trade in the house, except for the final clean.
Skipping the pad upgrade to shave a day. Pad is in stock. It never delays a job, and it decides how the carpet feels and lasts.
Booking install day for the same day as the movers. If the roll is late or a subfloor needs repair, you have a house full of boxes on bare plywood.

blocks.text: How to shorten your own lead time

items: Call as soon as you have a date, even a tentative one. A pencil hold on our calendar costs nothing.
Ask which samples are in-stock products and shortlist from those if the date is fixed.
Decide fiber and pad before the estimate so the visit ends with an order, not a second appointment.
Clear the rooms yourself; empty rooms can be installed on short-notice cancellation days.
Tell us about pets, stairs and known squeaks so the crew brings the right materials the first time.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book carpet installation for a move-in date?
faq.a: Schedule the estimate five to eight weeks before the move. That gives time to choose, order and install with a buffer. For an in-stock carpet in an empty house we can often finish within two to three weeks, but special orders need six to ten.

faq.q: How long does carpet take to arrive after ordering?
faq.a: Stock carpet from a regional warehouse typically arrives within a week. Special-order colors, wool and patterned products ship from the mill and take three to six weeks. We confirm the ship date before you commit, and we inspect every roll before it is cut.

faq.q: Can Wills Flooring install carpet in a Lynnwood home in one week?
faq.a: Sometimes. If you choose an in-stock product at the estimate, the house is empty and our calendar has an opening, one week is realistic. It is not something to plan around. If your date is fixed, book earlier and treat a fast turnaround as a bonus.

faq.q: Is there a best time of year to schedule carpet installation?
faq.a: January through March. Calendars are open, mills ship quickly and you can pick your date. The hardest window is mid-October through December. The labor rate does not move with the season: $0.99 per sq ft and $30 a step in December as in February.

faq.q: Should carpet go in before or after painting?
faq.a: After. Carpet is one of the last trades in a remodel or move-in refresh. Paint, trim and any subfloor repairs first, then carpet, then a final clean. Installing carpet early only invites drips and ladder marks on a brand-new floor.

faq.q: How long does the carpet installation itself take?
faq.a: One long day for a typical Lynnwood upstairs of three or four bedrooms and a hall, or a straight staircase plus two rooms. Whole-house jobs with furniture moves and removal of old carpet usually take two days. You can walk on it the same evening.
